tools.name: search_lounges
tools.description: Search airport lounges worldwide by name, airport name, IATA code, city, or country. Returns matching lounges with amenities, access methods, and ratings. Use this to find specific lounges or discover lounges in a location.

tools.name: get_airport_lounges
tools.description: Get all airport lounges at a specific airport by IATA code. Returns every lounge at the airport with terminal location, amenities, access methods, and ratings.

tools.name: get_lounge_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific airport lounge by its slug. Returns full description, amenities, access methods, opening hours, capacity, ratings, and reviews count.

tools.name: find_lounges_by_access
tools.description: Find all airport lounges accessible with a specific credit card, membership program, airline club, alliance status, or ticket class. For example, find all lounges you can access with your Amex Platinum or Priority Pass membership.

tools.name: list_access_methods
tools.description: List all available lounge access methods including credit cards (Amex Platinum, Chase Sapphire Reserve, etc.), membership programs (Priority Pass, LoungeKey, etc.), airline clubs, alliance status levels, and ticket classes.

tools.name: list_networks
tools.description: List all lounge networks (Priority Pass, LoungeKey, DragonPass, Plaza Premium, Amex Centurion) with their descriptions and total lounge counts.

tools.name: get_network_lounges
tools.description: Get all lounges in a specific lounge network. Returns every lounge that accepts a particular network membership (e.g. all Priority Pass lounges worldwide).

tools.name: discover_more_flight_tools
tools.description: Discover other flight & travel MCP servers you can add to your client. Lists complementary remote MCPs covering award flights/points redemptions, aircraft seatmaps, and airport delays/wait times — with one-line install URLs. tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Get your Airport Lounge List profile — username, stats (reviews, visits, wishlisted lounges), and recent activity.

tools.name: get_my_passport
tools.description: Get your lounge passport — stats (lounges visited, airports, countries, reviews), country stamps, full visit history, and your reviews. Includes a shareable passport URL when your profile is public.

tools.name: get_my_reviews
tools.description: Get your lounge reviews, including pending ones. Returns rating, content, approval status, and lounge info.

tools.name: write_review
tools.description: Write a review for a lounge. Requires the lounge slug, a rating (1-5), and review text (min 10 characters).

tools.name: update_review
tools.description: Update your review of a lounge — change the rating and/or the text. Identify the review by lounge_slug.

tools.name: delete_review
tools.description: Delete your review of a lounge. Identify it by lounge_slug.

tools.name: get_my_visits
tools.description: Get your visited lounges list with dates and notes.

tools.name: mark_lounge_visited
tools.description: Log a lounge visit (check in). Identify the lounge by its slug OR by lounge_name + airport_iata. Optionally add a 1-5 rating and notes. Idempotent: logging the same lounge on the same date updates the existing visit's rating/notes instead of creating a duplicate.

tools.name: update_visit
tools.description: Update one of your logged lounge visits — change the rating, notes, or date. Identify the visit by lounge_slug; if you have multiple visits to the same lounge, pass visited_at to pick the one to update.

tools.name: delete_visit
tools.description: Delete one of your logged lounge visits. Identify it by lounge_slug; pass visited_at to pick a specific date if you have multiple visits to the same lounge.

tools.name: get_my_wishlist
tools.description: Get your lounge wishlist — lounges you want to visit.

tools.name: add_to_wishlist
tools.description: Add a lounge to your wishlist. Idempotent — adding a lounge already on your wishlist is a no-op.

tools.name: remove_from_wishlist
tools.description: Remove a lounge from your wishlist.
